family_name: Bradford Wall Wraps - Light Duty Residential

spec.description:
Bradford Enviroseal ProctorWrap Residential Wall (RW) is a Light
Duty, Class 4 vapour-permeable wall wrap designed for residential timber and
steel frame wall construction. Engineered with a triple-layer polyolefin
spunbond textile, it allows interior moisture vapour to breathe outward,
mitigating condensation, timber rot, and mould growth behind external claddings.
Acting as a water barrier against wind-driven rain and an effective air barrier
against drafts, it delivers high energy efficiency and weather tightness for
homes built with brick veneer, timber weatherboards, fibre cement, or composite
cladding.
features:
Highly vapour permeable (Class 4) allowing moisture
to escape the building envelope

Water barrier performance protects frame and
wall insulation from wind-driven rain

Air barrier functionality seals
external walls against conditioned air leakage and drafts

Triple-layer
spunbond polyolefin construction provides excellent tear resistance

Printed
with a 150mm lap line for accurate on-site installation and alignment

Soft,
non-woven facing prevents noisy flapping in windy conditions

Lightweight and
easy to cut and fix around window and door frames

Suitable for brick, timber,
steel, fibre-cement, and Hebel residential constructions

technical.value:
1500 mm width x 50 m length

2750 mm width x 25 m length (68.75 m² per roll)

spec.compliance:

spec.sustainability:

non-hazardous, 100% recyclable polyolefin materials, low VOC
install:
Fix
Enviroseal RW to the outside of timber or steel studs with printed side facing
outward

Fasten with broad-headed nails or staples at maximum 300mm centres to
studs and plates

Run sheets horizontally starting from the bottom plate,
ensuring overlaps shed water downward

Overlap consecutive horizontal sheets
by at least 150mm along the printed lap guide

Vertical joints must overlap by
at least 150mm and be made over a structural stud

Tape all joins and
penetrations with Bradford Enviroseal HighTack Tape or specify RW-IT

Ensure
membrane is separated from cladding by a ventilated/drained cavity
selection_checklist:
Confirm residential wall construction requires a
Class 4 vapour-permeable membrane

Choose roll width (1.5m standard vs 2.75m
wide roll to wrap single-storey walls in one drop)

Calculate roll quantity
based on total wall area allowing 150mm overlaps

Select standard RW or RW-IT
with integrated adhesive tape

Order complementary HighTack Tape for window
and door flashings
limitations:
Not suitable for roofing applications (Light Duty rating does
not meet DtS roof requirements)

Must not be left exposed to direct UV
sunlight for more than 30 days

Not designed for open-joint rainscreens (use
Black Label)

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Wall Wraps - Light
Duty Residential (Enviroseal ProctorWrap Residential Wall / RW, product
codes 118153 / 138628) is a premium Light Duty, Class 4 vapour-permeable wall
wrap designed for residential timber and steel stud construction. Featuring a
triple-layer non-woven polyolefin textile, it lets interior moisture vapour
escape to prevent condensation, rot, and mould while acting as a barrier against
wind-driven rain and drafts. Available in 1500mm and 2750mm roll widths with a
Flammability Index ≤ 5 (BAL 12.5-40 compliant), it provides a durable, quiet
weatherproofing layer behind residential brick veneer, weatherboards, and
lightweight claddings.
